title: PR #103: docs(architecture): define decentralized AI OS architecture
content:
State: open
Merged: False
Draft: False

## Summary

Adds a system-level architecture specification for the decentralized AI operating system, aligned with the canonical L0–L7 + X architecture and existing SSOT boundaries.

## Scope

- Defines ShivaCore, GlobusOS, Aurora AI, decentralized identity/networking, and A-TownChain responsibilities.
- Specifies the identity/key-management, policy/capability, and software/model supply-chain cross-cutting controls.
- Defines the authorized Aurora action path from proposal through policy, capability enforcement, service boundary, authoritative execution, and evidence.
- Defines isolated registries, repository ownership, phased delivery, acceptance criteria, and exact-SHA evidence semantics.
- Explicitly labels the document as an architecture proposal, not implementation or production-readiness evidence.

## SSOT / Governance

- System-level architecture only; no component implementation is duplicated.
- Normative standards remain owned by `atc-standards`.
- Canonical ATC-VM and algorithm remain in `a-townchain/components/vm` and `a-townchain/components/algorithm`.
- Related master architecture: #71.

## Validation

- Documentation-only change.
- CI/evidence gates remain authoritative; no gate weakening.
- This PR does not claim that the specified capabilities are implemented or verified.

Closes no issue automatically; review and evidence are required before merge.
